notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for a successful timestamped interaction service report. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM data elements, standard logical-time interfaces, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, ordinary FOM, standard MIM, logical-time implementation, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies typed success reports, timestamped delivery, retraction metadata, logical-time grants, payload preservation, and application-callback ordering without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped SendInteraction success path and FederateAmbassador service-report and receiveInteraction delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador, FederateAmbassador, and logical-time service-report declarations
